notes: `מִקְּרֵה־לָיְלָה` is split: `מִן` takes *by reason of* headed on *reason* (rule 24), the construct noun carries the recast headless relative (rule 46), and the rectum carries *by night* (rule 19).
The supplied object *him* answers to no morpheme and is `added` (rule 44).

`מִחוּץ` and `אֶל־תּוֹךְ` each meet rule 30's one-rendering condition and are headed on their construct nouns; the `אֶל` before the compound and the following `לְ` are left `unrepresented` under rule 40.
